title: Bottom Navigation
description: The mobile app tab bar: three to five destinations under the thumb, the current one lit with the core.
usage: For app-shaped pages on phones: the destinations a thumb can reach, always in the same order. Three to five items; a sixth means the app needs a menu, not a wider bar. The part ships the bar — fixing it to the viewport bottom is the page’s job.
a11y: A nav landmark of real links, each with an icon and a text label — the label is what the screen reader reads, so never ship the icon-only variant to production without aria-labels.
